items.title: On an affine scheme whose points are closed with separably algebraically closed residue fields all higher cohomology vanishes
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the vanishing of the higher etale cohomology on an affine scheme all of whose points are closed with separably algebraically closed residue fields (statement lines 14279-14286). The proof (proof lines 14288-14300) identifies the underlying space as profinite, whence the Zariski cohomology vanishes, and identifies the local rings as strictly henselian, whence etale and Zariski cohomology agree. H2: two identifications plus the comparison.
